title: Got any Grapes?
description: A resturant managment game that was inspired by the duck song
how-to-play: Objective is the serve the ducks before time runs out, you have 3 lives drag objects around by clicking on them, there is a trash on the bottom right to get rid of and object. To serve duck simply drag an object onto a request bubble and click on it. How to make Lemonade: First pick up lemon and then click on the jug, dispose of lemon, put glass on to the placement area and use the jug to fill the glass with lemonade.
